message: Herbary team this is Grace Wonjiru the CHV from Rongai. I want to report on todays family planning outreach at Kampi Yamoto dispensary. We started at 9 in the morning with a short talk on the different methods than the nurse Sister Mary Chebet gave services. In total 42 women came and most of them were young mothers. 6 women were referred to Rongai Health Center for implants because we ran out of stock. 1 mama asked to be called for follow-up her number is 0711-000482. I will send the register tomorrow. Thank you

message: Hi Tim Beatrice Otino here reporting from the Too Many Women's group meeting in Nogosho. Today was our monthly table banking day. 25 members attended out of 30. Together they saved 18,000 shillings and we gave out 4 small loans to members who are starting businesses mostly selling vegetables and second-hand clothes. The treasurer Mama Lucy Kiprop recorded everything in the book.Our next meeting is on the 15th. If you need the records Lucy s number is 0745-000638.

message: Morning everyone this is Janet Mwangi. Yesterday we went to Sarambiai Primary School for the menstrual hygiene session with the girls in class 6-8. 60 girls attended. We talked about periods how to use and dispose of pads safely and why they should not miss school. At the end every girl received a pack of reusable sanitary pads. The head teacher Mrs. Esther Koch has asked us to come back and also talk to the mothers. Her phone number is 0790-000274 if someone wants to follow up.

message: Hello team Ditsmasiwambui I want to share about the community dialogue on gender-based violence we held this afternoon at the chiefs camp in Solai. 35 women attended plus a few village elders. The police gender desk officer Corporal Enmuchwa explained how to report cases and where survivors can get help. Some women shared their stories it was very emotional. 3 women asked for private follow-up and we connected them with the counselor. For anything about this session you can call me on 0701-000-593.

message: Hi everyone Sister Nancy Sheaono here. Today we did the cervical cancer screening camp at Rongai Health Center. We screened 28 women. Most results were normal but 3 women had positive results so we referred them to Nakuru Level 5 Hospital for further treatment. 1 of them is Mrs Agnes Wairimu and she has agreed to go on Monday. Please whoever is going to Nakuru that day help her with transport. Her number is 0768-000341 I will upload the full report later.

message: Hello team this is Caroline Nyambura reporting from Camp Yamoto. Today we held the kitchen garden training for women farmers. 18 women attended. The agriculture officer Mr Peter Langart showed them how to make a sack garden and how to make compost from kitchen waste. Each woman received seedlings of Sukuma wiki and spinach to plant at home. Next month we will visit their homes to see how the gardens are doing. If you want to join the follow-up visits call me on 0712-000765.
